about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Pendant: Fluttering Myriads

A pendant where 3 beautiful Myriads will flutter behind you.

Enjoy the hunting life while equipped with a special pendant!

*You can apply pendants from the Appearance Menu in your tent. Select Equipment Appearance to apply to your Hunter, or Seikret Customization to apply to your Seikret.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
